name: Get Variable
description: Generic Blueprint node generated for each member variable. A pure (no exec) function call that simply returns the current value of a member variable on the target object. Behavior and pin types depend entirely on the variable's declared type.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The object instance to read the variable from. Hidden when accessed from 'self'. Connect an actor/component reference to read a variable on it.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: The current value of the variable. Type matches the variable's declared type (bool, int, float, string, Vector, struct, object reference, etc.).
